[[Kaanai Canyon (Kurzick)|Kaanai Canyon]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance battle]]s from the Kurzick side.

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Kurzick Kommandant]] at a Kurzick [[guild hall]] when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is in deep [[Luxon]] territory.
